LanguageData.UMW_WeaponEnabledDesc: Allow {0} to be generated. Turn off to remove it from this mod's own reward pool and from every vanilla generation and reward pool, including quest rewards, ancient crates, item stashes and map loot, so it no longer appears. (A third-party mod that rolls loot through its own custom generator may bypass this.) Any that already exist in your save are untouched, and the other weapons take its place in the rolls. Turning it back on is enough to restore it.
LanguageData.UMW_ExcludeWoodStuffDesc: Unique weapons only enter the game through generated rewards (quests, ancient crates, item stashes), rolled from a random eligible material. With this on, wooden materials are dropped from that roll, so a hard-won reward never lands as a wooden {0}. Turn off to allow wooden uniques.
LanguageData.UMW_AllowUltratechTraitsDesc: Three traits borrow Royalty's ultratech melee kit: {0} (a mechanite-held edge that shears armor), {1} (a plasma sheath that sears and ignites) and {2} (an EMP discharge that stuns mechanoids). Turn off to keep them out of the roll. This is meant for medieval-only or low-tech runs, where a mechanite edge on a hand-forged sword breaks the period. The other traits are unaffected, and weapons that have already rolled one of these keep it.
LanguageData.UMW_EarthshakeCooldownDesc: How long a piledriver weapon must rest between earthshakes. The default matches the cooldown on the EMP pulser, the one weapon-trait ability Odyssey ships with a cooldown. Set to 0 for no cooldown at all.
LanguageData.UMW_EarthshakeRadiusDesc: How far the stunning shockwave reaches. It travels through the ground, so walls do not stop it, but it cannot cross a gap with no floor. The overhead ripple scales to match. Remember the shock is indiscriminate: a wider radius catches more of your own colonists too.
LanguageData.UMW_RallyingCryCooldownDesc: How long a storied weapon must rest between rallying cries. Measured in days rather than hours on purpose: the default makes it an heirloom moment rather than a standing aura you re-apply every fight.
LanguageData.UMW_RallyingCryRadiusDesc: How far the cry carries. It rallies every humanlike within this range who is not hostile to the wielder and can see them, so allied and neutral pawns are included but walls and closed doors block it. Waking sleepers uses the same range but ignores walls, and catches enemies as well.
LanguageData.UMW_RalliedDurationDesc: How long the rallied buff lasts on each pawn the cry reaches, halving both their pain and the time a hit staggers them. Anyone who was asleep is woken instead of rallied, and resents it. Changing this affects cries made from now on; anyone already rallied keeps the duration they were given.
LanguageData.UMW_WarbandQuestWeightDesc: Selection weight of the warband quest against the other opportunity-site quests (ancient mercenaries, bandit camps, item stashes...) offered by traders, beggars and reading. Higher = offered more often. 0 disables the quest entirely.
